Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About the Commerce Platform Team
Commerce Platform is a foundational organization at Atlassian powering how products are
packaged, priced, billed, and managed across the ecosystem. It underpins quoting, billing,
subscription management, and payment orchestration across all Atlassian products and
customer segments. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will lead high-visibility
programs in close partnership with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-To-Market to build
durable, scalable capabilities for the future.

What you'll do

  • Drive Platform Strategy & Roadmaps: Partner with Product and Engineering
    leadership to define multi-year strategic roadmaps for core commerce capabilities
    (billing, quoting, subscription management, and payment processing).
  • Translate Business Strategy into Execution: Connect enterprise business models,
    global tax rules, multi-currency strategies, and compliance requirements to clear
    platform milestones and cross-team delivery plans.
  • Lead Flagship Commerce Programs: Orchestrate complex, multi-team programs from
    incept
